messages:
Priya (PM): Quick pivot checkin
We need to narrow the observability launch scope. Customers want fast error triage + cost transparency. Proposing an MVP that hits both.
Luis (Eng): Can you be specific on the triage flow? Is it alerts -> trace link -> log context? That defines the backend hooks we need.
Ivy (SRE): Prefer alerts -> top-5 error signatures -> sample trace link. Keep logs as a secondary click to avoid huge log egress. Also we must cap trace retention for MVP.
Nate (Design): I can mock a compact flow: alert banner -> error slice panel -> open trace flyout (inline). Will design a tiny timeline view to highlight slow spans.
Ravi (CS): Customer X requires cost by "project" + ability to export CSV for billing. Customer Y wants error rate breakouts by model version. Both are blockers for their GA.
Priya (PM): MVP scope suggestion: 1) error-slice panel (service + top error signatures), 2) cost-by-project tile (7/30d + CSV export), 3) trace link from slice -> trace flyout with sampled spans. Launch criteria: CSV export works, cost accuracy within 20% for 30d, trace flyout loads < 300ms for sampled traces.
Luis (Eng): Engineering constraints: cost-by-project needs join of billing tags with routing logs. If customers don't have consistent tags, accuracy suffers. We can add a tag-validation check in the UI.
Ivy (SRE): Operational constraints: sampling must be configurable per-tenant and have a default low-rate for high-traffic tenants. Retention: MVP = 48h of sampled traces. Also need soft quota alerts for trace storage.
Priya (PM): Tradeoffs: drop user-level breakdown for MVP (too high cardinality). Keep model-version and project tag only. Add tag-sanity check as Luis suggested.
Nate (Design): UX fallback if backend aggregation missing: show last-known snapshot + banner "data delayed" and a retry button. That avoids blank screens.
Ravi (CS): For Customer X, confirm they can run a weekly CSV export job as interim. I'll email them the CSV schema tomorrow.
Luis (Eng): Implementation plan: two-phase. Phase A (2 sprints): implement cost tile with project-tag join (single-region), error-slice panel with slice extraction service. Phase B (2 sprints): sampling controls, CSV export, cross-region rollup.
Priya (PM): Can we commit to canary policy? I propose canary cohort = 10% customers for phase A, monitor: cost-diff > 25% or trace-latency > 60s -> roll back.
Ivy (SRE): I'll own the canary automation and metrics. Will add probabilistic checks on cost delta and end-to-end latency.
Luis (Eng): Dev question: do we need a new index for slice extraction? That will add ops cost. If we approximate via recent logs instead of full indexes we can save weeks.
Priya (PM): Decision: approximate extraction for MVP (recent logs) and mark exact extraction for follow-up. Documented in scope.
Nate (Design): I'll update mocks to show "approximate" tag with tooltip explaining data freshness.
Ravi (CS): Customer Y needs model-version breakdown. We'll surface that under advanced filters (opt-in) to avoid high card default.
Priya (PM): Action items: Luis -> perf/sizing for slice extraction and cost join (due Tue), Ivy -> canary automation + SLOs (Mon), Nate -> updated mocks + tooltip copy (Mon), Ravi -> confirm CSV acceptance with Customer X (Tue).
deploy-bot: Deployed test feature-flag obs-mvp-2026 to staging namespace.
Ivy (SRE): Noted. I'll toggle flag for canary customers once canary cohorts ready.
Priya (PM): Thumbs if you agree with MVP scope and actions.
Luis (Eng): :+1:
Ivy (SRE): :thumbsup:
Nate (Design): :+1:
Ravi (CS): :+1:
Priya (PM): Closing thread, follow-up sync Fri 11am. If blockers pop up ping here.
